newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine court jails Briton for promoting child sex.
newsitem.headline: Philippine court jails Briton for promoting child sex.

text.p: A Philippine court on Friday convicted Briton Michael Clarke on charges of promoting child prostitution and sentenced him to 16 years in jail.
The court in Olongapo, north of Manila, also ordered Clarke deported immediately after completing his sentence.
"I shall be mounting a very strong appeal against this decision," Clarke told the court, claiming that the evidence against him had been fabricated.
Clarke, 48, from Eastbourne, had denied charges that he had promoted visits to the Philippines by paedophiles.
The Philippines has been cracking down on its international reputation as a haven for paedophiles and recently jailed an Australian and another Briton, both for up to 17 years.
